pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, jagged dark regions with sharp pixel gradients at edges. Spatial area is larger on the upper shoulder and neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented polygonal shapes on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Junction nodes are high-density with mostly tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the upper neck ridge, appearing as a dense, short-bristled contour against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent, localized circular area of textural disruption and de-pigmentation is visible on the upper flank near the dorsal ridge, appearing as a light-colored, scaly-textured void in the typical patch pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The large, circular depigmented lesion on the upper mid-flank indicates localized physical trauma or parasitic activity.
